rules.message: Children are inserted right after the parent row — the lazy row must declare data-hx-swap="afterend".
A lazy tree row must declare its children URL: data-hx-get on the row.
The first-expand fetch is opt-in: the row must carry data-lazy (installDatagrid() fires hc:datagridtreeload once and marks data-loaded).
An expandable row announces its state: aria-expanded on the row ("false" to start collapsed).
Give the lead cell a data-hc-datagrid-tree toggle (aria-hidden + tabindex="-1") — the mouse affordance; Enter on the cell covers keyboard.
